text:
claire: quick sync — deploy-bot scheduled a kernel/quant cutover tonight at 02:00 UTC for runtime-engine:v5.3.0-quant. planning to do regional staggered swap (us-east -> eu-west -> ap-south). can we confirm rollback windows and the signal list?

sam: ack. i can be on-call for the us-east cut. i'll watch p50/p95/p99, kv-cache evictions, and OOMs.

raj: i'll shadow telemetry and routing fallback. what are hard rollback triggers?

claire: suggested rollback triggers: 1) sustained p99 > 800ms for 10m, 2) error-rate > 0.5% (5m rolling), 3) any KV cache evictions causing >2% latency regressions, 4) crashloop or GPU OOMs. if any hit, we pin back to v5.2.8 and open rollback runbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled swap accepted. preflight: canary traffic slice 1% for 15m, then 10% for 20m, then 100% per-region. TTL pin on new image 2h.

claire: add: if canary shows tokenization mismatch or generation artifacts (we saw a weird tokenization case last month), immediate halt and pin. include quick eval prompt set: checkout /evals/regen-tokenization/sanity.

tess: ops checklist updated — i've added ancillary tasks: increase logging to DEBUG for kernel-binding for canary hosts, enable kv-cache debug sampling, and hold the night-window notification channel.

sam: release-notes blurb draft: "runtime-engine v5.3.0-quant — kernel optimizations for quant matmul, improved batching heuristics, and optional prefix-KV cache compatibility fixes. Backwards-incompatible ABI tweak guarded by runtime feature flag; fallback routing enabled." thoughts?

raj: sounds good. make sure we call out the known caveat: older dedicated pools running driver 510.xx may need driver pin or will auto-fallback to v5.2.8. add a link to the driver compatibility matrix.

claire: yep, i'll paste the driver matrix in #eng-runtime-notes before swap. also notify sales/cs (prod risk) that there will be a short change window and canary.

deploy-bot: preflight checks (passed): artifact checksum verified, canary infra allocated, smoke tests ok on staging. Pending manual hold from @claire for cutover.

claire: holding until 01:30 UTC for final signoff. anyone else joining the night window?

sam: i'll be there from 01:50 UTC.

raj: i'll join at 01:45 and monitor traces.

claire: thanks — final note: rollback procedure: run `deploy-bot pin runtime-engine v5.2.8 --regions <region>` then `deploy-bot rollback <cut-id>`; post-mortem template is in /runbooks/rollbacks/template. keep messages in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
